correctness.rationale: PASS: With the equal-circle norm, the Laurent basis z^n/sqrt(1+r^(2n)) diagonalizes the outer indicator with d(hn), d(t)=(1+exp(-2t))^-1, h=-log r. Identical angular data give the exact weighted Fourier shift with 0<u_nk<=1. The compression identity [PBP,PAP]=PAQBP-PBQAP and sum_n d_n(1-d_n)<infinity prove S2 for each bounded symbol even outside H1. Telescope each integer k difference in ell2 and apply interval Cauchy-Schwarz: F_h(k)<=h k^2 int|d'|^2=hk^2/3. Independently integrated (1/4)sech^4 over R to 1/3 and numerically computed F_h(k)/h ~ (0.3333205,1.3331286,2.9989635) for k=1,2,3 at h=.012 versus (1/3,4/3,3); the latter are finite diagnostics only. Fixed-mode dominated Riemann sums prove limit k^2/3; dominated convergence for a in H1 and Fatou for all other bounded a give the exact extended-real limit. The k=1 mode proves optimality. No claim for unequal circle measures.
